member.name: M:Dell.UnifiedAgent.Common.TypeExtensions.isPublishable(System.Type,Dell.Client.Framework.Common.ILog)
member.summary: Return true if the type meets all the requirements for being published.
member.remarks:
A type can only be published if it meets these requirements:
Is public
No properties
No generic methods
All methods return void, Task, Task<T>, ValueTask, ValueTask<T>, or IAsyncEnumerable<T>.
All events are typed with EventHandler or EventHandler<T>.The JSON-RPC contract for raising such events is that the request contain exactly one argument, which supplies the value for the T in EventHandler<T>.
Methods may accept a CancellationToken as the last parameter.
For More info see
member.returns: false if the Type is not truly async
